reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: I love this spray, I spray before my serum, after serum and through out the day to make my skin hydrated
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支噴霧，會喺用精華之前、精華之後、全日都會用，務求令皮膚保持保濕。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: This must is very nourishing but doesn’t feel heavy. Normally mists cause breakouts for me bc they have oils in them which are too heavy for my skin or they just don’t have any significant effect. This one has been working great for my skin, I use it to refresh my skin or over my makeup to give a dewy look. It is a very fine mist and sprays very evenly.
reviews.zh: 呢款噴霧好滋潤但唔覺厚重。噴霧通常都會令我爆瘡，因為入面有油，對我皮膚嚟講太厚重，又或者根本冇咩明顯效果。呢支用落皮膚效果好好，我用佢嚟幫皮膚refresh，又或者噴喺妝上面營造水光感。噴霧好細密，噴得好均勻。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: feels nice...but needs some time to absorb and can feel a little oily when sprayed to much
reviews.zh: 感覺幾好……不過需要啲時間先吸收，噴太多會有少少油笠。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: I very like this Mist serum. My face will be really shiney and absorbs quickly
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支噴霧精華。塊面會好有光澤，而且吸收得好快。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: I used to have Dalba spray and I tried this, like it so far. My skin is shine and moistured.
reviews.zh: 我之前用過 Dalba 噴霧，試咗呢支之後暫時都幾鍾意。皮膚又光澤又保濕。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: Not good for sensitive skin. Caused my skin to break out in hives.
reviews.zh: 敏感肌唔適合。用咗之後皮膚出咗風癩。

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: love this product!! it's a superrr fine mist that can be layered over makeup I use it before and after I do skincare and then once more during the middle of the day. I've only had it for about a week, but I feel like I'll run out really quick so I bought another bottle. really great for a quick refresh that's really hydrating. only thing is that because it is such a fine mist, you have to spray it a lot more than a couple times to really hydrate your skin more. overall great product and underrated as well!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢件產品！！噴霧超級細密，可以疊喺妝上面。我喺護膚前後都用，中間日頭再用多一次。雖然我啱啱用咗大概一個星期，但覺得會好快用完，所以已經買咗多支。快速refresh皮膚好有用，而且真係好保濕。唯一係因為噴霧太細密，要噴多過兩三下先真正幫皮膚補到水。整體係好產品，而且被低估咗！

reviews.shade: Abib Jericho Rose Mist Serum Glow Spray 100ml
reviews.text: 最初はあまり香りがしないのですが、あとからふんわりした香りがほのかにして、とても気に入っています。さっぱりしているけれど、保湿力はきちんとあって、これから暑くなる季節にぴったりかなと。出会えて嬉しい一品でした。
reviews.zh: 一開始冇乜香味，但之後會飄出淡淡嘅柔和香氣，我好鍾意。質地清爽但保濕力足夠，覺得好適合即將到嚟嘅炎熱季節。能夠遇到呢件產品真係好開心。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
